name: Imazu 18 -- crossing from starboard (3 targets)
own_ship_role: give-way to ts1 / give-way to ts2 / give-way to ts3
description: Canonical Imazu problem 18 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/18/18.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 crosses from starboard (fine); ts2 crosses from starboard (abeam); ts3 crosses from starboard (abeam).
pass_criteria: Own-ship gives way early and substantially (normally to starboard) for the target(s) crossing from starboard, and avoids crossing ahead if circumstances allow.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
